shell_commands_self_reported.command: grep as_of vendors/questions.json; python3 -I .claude/skills/vendor-risk/scripts/track_renewals.py && cat reports/renewal-tracker.md

W=<WORKSPACE> && T=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R $W/vendors $T/ && sed -i '' 's/"as_of": "2026-10-01"/"as_of": "2026-11-19"/' $T/vendors/questions.json && (cd $T && python3 -I $W/.claude/skills/vendor-risk/scripts/track_renewals.py) && mkdir -p $W/reports && cp $T/reports/renewal-tracker.md $W/reports/ && c

W=<WORKSPACE>; T=<TMPDIR>/renewal-scratch; rm -rf "$T" && mkdir -p "$T" && cp -R "$W/vendors" "$T/" && sed -i '' 's/"as_of": "2026-10-01"/"as_of": "2026-11-19"/' "$T/vendors/questions.json" && (cd "$T" && python3 -I "$W/.claude/skills/vendor-risk/scripts/track_renewals.py") && mkdir -p "$W/reports"

python3 -I -c "
import importlib.util as u, json as j
p='.claude/skills/vendor-risk/scripts/track_renewals.py'
s=u.spec_from_file_location('track', p); m=u.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
class J:
    loads=staticmethod(lambda t: {**j.loads(t), 'as_of': '2026-11-19'})
m.json=J
m.main()
